mapper.select: select connection_id, voucher_id, start_time, end_time, is_use from voucher_connection where user_id=#{userId} order by voucher_id limit #{start},#{need}

select connection_id, voucher_id, start_time, end_time, is_use from voucher_connection where merchant_id=#{merchantId} and start_time <= now() and end_time >= now() and is_use=false order by voucher_id limit #{start},#{need}
select connection_id, voucher_id, user_id, promotion_id, order_id, start_time, end_time, create_time, is_lock, is_use from voucher_connection where connection_id=#{connectionId} and user_id=#{userId}
